text: A link to another graph points to the Aimparency server hosting it, not to a local checkout
description:
Felix 2026-11-12: checking out other people's graphs locally is the problem. A link points for sure to the Aimparency server hosting the graph, maybe also to the repo.

Today (e81b11c3, 1585aa46): a linked repo is stored in meta.json as repoId, name and an optional url; where it is checked out is kept per machine in .bowman/runtime; without a local checkout the node is a grey stub.

Change: the stored link carries the address of the graph on its Aimparency server; the repo address stays optional. No server path and no checkout are needed to follow it.

This changes the stored format, so it needs a migration (AGENTS.md: BOWMAN_MIGRATIONS, version bump, frozen fixture of the previous format).

Assumed by Claude: links to locally checked-out repos keep working for self-hosting.

status.comment: 0101a3c3: data model 7, meta.linkedRepos entries carry host (<origin>/g/<slug>); links from before are kept unchanged (frozen fixture data-model-v6, migration test). linkedRepo.linkHost stores a link by address; the browser or MCP client asks the hosting server itself (fetchGraphAtHost, shared/graph-host.test.ts), this server never fetches foreign graphs. Settings dialog and MCP register_linked_repo link by address, also on a server with accounts; clicking a linked graph's node opens its host. Local-checkout links keep working. Evidence: backend linked-repos tests (43 with auth), verify:migration on v7 (898 ideas, graph unchanged), pnpm check 25/25. Not tried live between two running servers.
